text_block_list.name: A Certain Racer
text_block_list.text:
It started with playing tag against my
sister.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Racer
text_block_list.text:
Just meaningless running with my sister...
It was
nothing more than that.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Racer
text_block_list.text:
All I did was chase her—like a happy,
excited
little monster.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Racer
text_block_list.text:
Just moving my legs, filling my lungs
with air, then
moving my legs again—

text_block_list.name: A Certain Racer
text_block_list.text: That was how I breathed.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
After a while, my sister wasn't there for
me to
chase anymore.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I was alone.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
But even by myself, I remembered
exactly how I
breathed.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Then it clicked—my thirst is born of my
breathing.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
The harder I breathe, the thirstier I
become and
the less satisfied I am.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: But I can't stop breathing.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Even if every breath I drew were painful,
I'd have
to continue doing it in order to
live.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: But what if... what if my body...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
What if it one day rejects my breath?
Should such
a day come...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What am I supposed to do then?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Tch! I can't... lose!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: She's... still running, huh?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Tch... Mayano isn't my only opponent in
the
Arima. I'm going to beat her too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well, I don't know about you, Hishiama,
but
Mayano's next race is the
Takarazuka Kinen. She
has to get some
proper rest. Right, Mayano?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Are you listening, Mayano? Hey!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...I've got it.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hm? Mayano?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: It... can't be true...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: There's just no way!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Mayano?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... Huff...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
choice_data_list: 君は何がわかったんだ？
貴方は何がわかったの？

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I realized something.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Look at how brightly the sun is twinkling
right
now—and yet it's setting.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
If I don't hurry, it'll set. Then I won't be
able to
reach it anymore.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I won't get my chance to run with it!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: That obvious, huh?
choice_data_list: ナリタブライアンのことか
ナリタブライアンのこと？

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I thought about everything that's
happened up
until now.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: She just wanted to be excited.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
She just wanted to run with all her might
and say,
"That was fun."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
She's been fighting for so long, hoping
that she'd
one day be able to say that.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Even if it meant dragging along a body
that
wouldn't respond to her desire to
twinkle.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer! I don't wanna back down like
this!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
If the Arima Kinen is really going to be
her last
race...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Then I wanna beat her on that day as
Mayano
Top Gun. I wanna smile and
say...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
When I run with everything I've got, I'm
faster
than you running with everything
you've got!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
And that's got you totally excited, hasn't
it?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yep! I'm gonna do it—just you wait and
see!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna get stronger at the
Takarazuka Kinen,
and faster at the
autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: And then at the Arima Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: If I beat her...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I want you to look at me—and me
alone—and say,
"You twinkled brighter
than anyone else."
